November 5, 1936. Morning Translation.

Shun Pao publishes the following article contributed by Yang
Chien lin (楊繼明) :-

ABOLITION OF MUNICIPAL ORCHESTRA ADVOCATED

Owing to financial stringency, the S.M.C.
is enforcing a policy of retrenchment. This merits
the approval of the public. However, there seem to be
many irregularities in this policy of retrenchment.
The S.M.C. has a Municipal Orchestra of
more than 50 musicians. For the upkeep of this Orchestra
the S.M.C. spends a sum of $300,000 annually. The
Orchestra is being maintained for the enjoyment and
pleasure of a small section of foreign residents and high
class Chinese citizens. In our opinion, the Orchestra
should be abolished. The Council recently engaged a
well-known British musician as bandmaster. In reducing
the salary of its junior employees rather than dissolving
this band, the Council seems to be working for the high
class section of the community only.

Central China Daily News (Taiyuan telegram):

THE ACTIVITIES OF A KOREAN COMMUNIST AT TAIYUAN

A report published recently by a certain
paper in Tientsin stated that a Korean doctor named Fu
Chia Sun (傅家孫) has been placed under surveillance by
the Taiyuan authorities.
Enquiries made by our reporter in official
circles reveal that Fu Chia Sun came to Taiyuan in June
1933 and took a house at No.69 Shan Siao Ziang (山小巷).
On a census form, he gave his native place as Suitah
Hsien (綏化縣), Heilungkiang Province, claimed to be a
fellow provincial of Dr. Ti Chien Loong (翟建龍), ex-Chief
of the Provincial Department of Reconstruction. Later,
he petitioned the Bureau of Public Safety for a certificate
to permit him to practise medicine. In the petition he
claimed to be a native of Suitah. A certificate was
issued to him.
In the course of a raid on the headquarters
of the Communist Party in Shansi, a document relating to
Fu Chia Sun was found. On January 19, 1934, Fu Chia
Sun was arrested, and a search of his house resulted in
the seizure of three pamphlets entitled "The Taiyuan Red
Flag," "The National Defence of the Soviets," and "The
Communist Youth League." Fu Chia Sun was sentenced
by the Shansi High Court to three years' imprisonment and
sent to the Shansi Reformatory from which he was discharged
in May this year.
Upon his release, Fu Chia Sun petitioned
the Bureau of Public Safety for permission to establish
a hospital in Taiyuan, but the petition was rejected and
his certificate to practise medicine was cancelled. Fu
Chia Sun, however, continued his preparations for the
opening of a hospital.
Upon learning of this, the Bureau of Public
Safety on October 17 ordered Fu Chia Sun to leave Taiyuan.

1936年11月5日。晨间译件。

《申报》刊登杨继明（Yang Chien lin）投稿文章如下：-

主张撤销工部局乐队

鉴于财政紧缩，上海公共租界工部局（S.M.C.）正在推行缩减开支政策。此举值得公众认可。然而，该缩减政策中似乎存在诸多不规范之处。工部局拥有一支由50多名乐手组成的工部局乐队。为维持该乐队，工部局每年耗资30万元。该乐队的维持仅是为了满足少数外籍居民和华人上层人士的享乐与消遣。我方认为，该乐队应予撤销。工部局近期聘请了一位著名的英国音乐家担任乐队指挥。工部局宁愿降低初级雇员的薪水，也不愿解散该乐队，此举似乎表明其仅在为社区内的上层阶级谋利。

《华中日报》（太原电）：

一名朝鲜共产主义者在太原的活动

天津某报近日刊登一则报道，称一名名为傅家孙（Fu Chia Sun）的朝鲜籍医生已受到太原当局的监视。
本报记者在官方渠道查询获悉，傅家孙于1933年6月抵达太原，并在山小巷69号租赁了一处住房。在人口普查表上，他填报的籍贯为黑龙江省绥化县，并声称是前省建设厅厅长翟建龙（Ti Chien Loong）博士的同乡。随后，他向公安局申请行医执照。在申请书中，他自称是绥化人。当局向其颁发了执照。
在对山西共产党总部的一次突袭搜查中，发现了一份涉及傅家孙的文件。1934年1月19日，傅家孙被捕，对其住所的搜查缴获了三本小册子，标题分别为《太原红旗》、《苏维埃的国防》和《共产主义青年团》。傅家孙被山西高等法院判处三年监禁，并送入山西感化院，于今年五月获释出狱。
获释后，傅家孙向公安局申请在太原设立医院，但该申请被驳回，其行医执照也被吊销。然而，傅家孙继续为开设医院做准备。
公安局获悉此事后，于10月17日命令傅家孙离开太原。
